entries.title: Job 19:1
segments: ¶Then Job answered and said:

entries.title: Job 19:2
segments: "How long will you torment my soul, And break me in pieces with words?

entries.title: Job 19:3
segments: These ten times you have reproached me; You are not ashamed [that] you have wronged me.

entries.title: Job 19:4
segments: And if indeed I have erred, My error remains with me.

entries.title: Job 19:5
segments: If indeed you exalt [yourselves] against me, And plead my disgrace against me,

entries.title: Job 19:6
segments: Know then that God has wronged me, And has surrounded me with His net.

entries.title: Job 19:7
segments: "If I cry out concerning wrong, I am not heard. If I cry aloud, [there is] no justice.

entries.title: Job 19:8
segments: ¶He has fenced up my way, so that I cannot pass; And He has set darkness in my paths.

entries.title: Job 19:9
segments: He has stripped me of my glory, And taken the crown [from] my head.

entries.title: Job 19:10
segments: He breaks me down on every side, And I am gone; My hope He has uprooted like a tree.

entries.title: Job 19:11
segments: He has also kindled His wrath against me, And He counts me as [one of] His enemies.

entries.title: Job 19:12
segments: His troops come together And build up their road against me; They encamp all around my tent.

entries.title: Job 19:13
segments: "He has removed my brothers far from me, And my acquaintances are completely estranged from me.

entries.title: Job 19:14
segments: My relatives have failed, And my close friends have forgotten me.

entries.title: Job 19:15
segments: Those who dwell in my house, and my maidservants, Count me as a stranger; I am an alien in their sight.

entries.title: Job 19:16
segments: I call my servant, but he gives no answer; I beg him with my mouth.

entries.title: Job 19:17
segments: My breath is offensive to my wife, And I am repulsive to the children of my own body.

entries.title: Job 19:18
segments: Even young children despise me; I arise, and they speak against me.

entries.title: Job 19:19
segments: All my close friends abhor me, And those whom I love have turned against me.

entries.title: Job 19:20
segments: My bone clings to my skin and to my flesh, And I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.

entries.title: Job 19:21
segments: "Have pity on me, have pity on me, O you my friends, For the hand of God has struck me!

entries.title: Job 19:22
segments: Why do you persecute me as God [does], And are not satisfied with my flesh?

entries.title: Job 19:23
segments: ¶"Oh, that my words were written! Oh, that they were inscribed in a book!

entries.title: Job 19:24
segments: That they were engraved on a rock With an iron pen and lead, forever!

entries.title: Job 19:25
segments: For I know [that] my Redeemer lives, And He shall stand at last on the earth;

entries.title: Job 19:26
segments: And after my skin is destroyed, this [I know], That in my flesh I shall see God,

entries.title: Job 19:27
segments: Whom I shall see for myself, And my eyes shall behold, and not another. [How] my heart yearns within me!

entries.title: Job 19:28
segments: If you should say, 'How shall we persecute him?' -Since the root of the matter is found in me,

entries.title: Job 19:29
segments: Be afraid of the sword for yourselves; For wrath [brings] the punishment of the sword, That you may know [there is] a judgment."
